snippet.title: Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Launch Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
snippet.description: For the first time in more than two decades, a new campaign has arrived in Warcraft III: Reforged. Forsaken Kingdom follows the fall of Lordaeron and its transformation into becoming the Undercity, introducing new faces alongside familiar figures, like Sylvanas, as players discover what it truly means to be Forsaken.
